items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, I met his brother... But he spelled Braut a different way. Because Wellman spelled in B-r-a-u-x.

ctx.x: Yeah, I met his brother, I think it
was. But he spelled Braut a different way. Because Wellman spelled in B-r-a-u-x. But down there they spelled it B-r-e-a-u-x.
Oh, yeah, yeah. Yes, yes, it's a French name.
